headline: Earnings climb as margins widen despite lower revenue
summary_short: Q2 revenue fell 4.1% y/y to $4.36B (up 6.2% q/q) while net income rose 63.6% y/y to $561M and diluted EPS climbed 55.1% y/y to $1.38, as operating income grew 40.9% y/y to $1.09B.
summary_long: Revenue declined 4.1% y/y to $4.36B (+6.2% q/q) even as operating income rose 40.9% y/y to $1.09B, EBIT rose 33.9% y/y to $1.19B, and net income climbed 63.6% y/y to $561M; diluted EPS rose 55.1% y/y to $1.38. The filed exhibit is Edison International's strategic business-update deck, not a quarterly MD&A, so it states no quarter-specific revenue or cost driver. The company reaffirms full-year Core EPS guidance of $5.90-6.20 for 2026 (midpoint $6.05), $6.25-6.65 for 2027, and $6.74-7.14 for 2028, underpinned by a $38-41B 2026-2030 capital plan and ~7% projected rate-base CAGR, with no equity issuance forecasted through 2030.
